blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment.
While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigates sparse rewards using hindsight information, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood.
Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step , defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget.
However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments.
To bridge this gap, we present P ivot-Aware I nternalized V isual O n-Policy T raining ( PIVOT ), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives.
At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped.
Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( + 8 % +8\% over SFT+GRPO baseline and + 5 % +5\% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B ( + 12 % +12\% over SFT+GRPO baseline).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm for vision-language model (VLM) agents ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
The prevailing RLVR framework, Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , samples multiple rollouts per prompt and computes relative advantages by normalizing episode-level returns within each group.
However, as analyzed in Sec. 2.1 (Fig. (a)) across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, GRPO suffers from two critical failure modes: zero-gradient silence , where the policy gradient vanishes as the group returns are identical ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , and coarse episode-level credit assignment , which ranks entire trajectories by scalar returns without pinpointing which step first renders the task unrecoverable ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Uesato et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
强化学习(RL)已经成为视觉语言模型代理商的主导培训后范式(欧阳等人,2022年;郭等人,2025年;姚等人,2023年;王等人,2026年b;沈等人,2025年;李等人,2026年).
流行的RLVR框架,Group-Relative Policy Observation (GRPO)(Shao等人,2024年),对每次即时推出的多个版本进行抽样,并通过使每组内部的集级回报正常化来计算相对优势.
然而,如第2.1条(图(a))中分析的,GRPO有两种关键的失败模式:零梯度沉默,即政策梯度随着群体返回而消失(Yu等人,2026年),以及粗糙的插曲级信用分配,即通过分级返回来排列整个轨迹,但没有指明哪个步骤使任务无法恢复(Lightman等人,2024年;Uesato等人,2022年)。

blocks.en:
On-Policy Distillation (OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) mitigates sparse rewards via token-level supervision, but fundamentally requires access to white-box teacher logits and matched vocabularies.
To bypass these constraints, On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) performs self-supervision by conditioning policy updates on hindsight information.
However, the mechanisms driving OPSD/OPD gains in multi-turn VLM agents remain poorly understood.
To figure out these underlying mechanisms, we conduct counterfactual probes by systematically rolling back the environment to the pivot step , defined as the first unrecoverable action within the remaining step budget, and then resampling trajectory suffixes to evaluate the performance gains.
blocks.zh:
On-Political Dispiration(OPD)(Agarwal等人,2024年;Lu等人,2026年)通过象征性的监督减轻了微薄的回报,但从根本上来说,需要获得白盒教师日志和匹配词汇.
为绕过这些限制,政策上的自我扭曲(OPSD)(Wang等人,2026a); Zhao等人, 2026年; Andrychowicz等人, 2017年; Shinn等人, 2023年)通过对事后信息进行政策更新来进行自我监督.
然而,推动OPSD/OPD在多回合VLM代理中取得进展的机制仍然不甚了解。
为了找出这些基本机制,我们进行反事实探测,系统地将环境回落到关键步骤中,被定义为剩余步骤预算范围内的第一个无法恢复的行动,然后对轨迹后缀进行重新取样,以评估绩效收益。

blocks.en: Empirically, as shown in Sec. 2.2 and Figs. (b)–(c), our probe reveals three key findings: (i) Restoring the environment state to the pivot step without any skill hints provides the primary share of suffix return lift and substantially reduces zero-advantage GRPO groups; (ii) Delaying this state reset by even a single step ( t ∗ + 1 t^{\ast}{+}1 ) causes suffix return gains to sharply diminish; and (iii) Incorporating explicit skill hints, whether self-generated or teacher-provided, yields only marginal incremental gains over hint-free state restoration (Fig. (b)). These observations yield a vital insight: the efficacy of OPD/OPSD in multi-turn VLM agents is largely driven by precise state rollbacks at the pivot step, rather than by additional skill prompting .
blocks.zh: 经验显示,正如第2.2节和图(b)-(c)所示,我们的调查揭示了三个主要结果:(一) 在没有任何技能提示的情况下使环境状态恢复到枢轴步骤,提供了后缀返回升降的主要份额,并大大减少了零优势GRPO组别;(二) 拖延这一状态的重置,甚至单步(t * + 1 t^{\ast}{+}1)会导致后缀返回收益急剧减少;(三) 纳入明确的技能提示,无论是自产生还是教师提供的,在无提示状态恢复之后只产生边际增益(图(b))。 这些观察得出了一个至关重要的见解:OPD/OPSD在多回合的VLM代理中的效力主要由枢轴步骤上精确的状态回滚驱动,而不是由额外的技能推动.

blocks.en: However, state rollback is computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world, non-rewindable environments, while inference cannot tolerate additional skill prompt overhead. Therefore, a practical RL framework for multi-turn VLM agents must: (i) non-invasively and precisely localize the pivot step directly from trajectory histories, and (ii) convert this localized pivot step into fine-grained, token-level policy gradients wihout environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time.
blocks.zh: 然而,从计算上讲,国家回滚在现实世界中是令人望而却步的,在不可倒转的环境中是行不通的,而推论则不能容忍技能迅速增加。 因此,多回合VLM代理商的实用RL框架必须:(一) 直接从轨迹史上对枢轴步骤进行非侵入和精确的本地化;(二) 将这种局部化的枢轴步骤转换成精细的、象征性的政策梯度,在RL培训和试验时进行额外技能提示时回滚。

blocks.en:
To this end, we present P ivot-Aware I nternalized V isual O n-Policy T raining ( PIVOT ), an on-policy distillation framework that internalizes pivot step localization and failure diagnostic hints directly into parameter updates without simulator rollbacks (Fig. 1 , Sec. 3 ).
In Stage I, a lightweight SFT phase cold-starts a failure Analyzer to non-invasively predict the pivot step, failure mode, and optional guidance skills directly from visual trajectory collages and action logs (Sec. 3.1 ).
In Stage II, a three-role unified architecture orchestrates training by consolidating Student, Analyzer, and Teacher roles within shared parameters: the Analyzer extracts a localized visual panel around the pivot step, combining it with the predicted failure mode and guidance skills to construct a privileged context.
A detached Teacher then re-scores original failed tokens under this privileged context, while the Student optimizes joint GRPO and Gated OPD objectives (Sec. 3.2 ).
At test time, both Analyzer and Teacher are stripped away, deploying the agent strictly as an unprivileged Student with zero computational and skill prompt overhead. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • Mechanistic Insight into OPSD: We characterize GRPO failure modes in multi-turn VLM agents and empirically analyze via counterfactual rollback probes that the OPSD/OPD performance gains stem mainly from state rollback at the critical pivot step, rather than skill hints as additional prompts. • Non-Invasive Pivot Step Localization: We propose PIVOT , introducing a trajectory Analyzer that non-invasively localizes pivot steps and provide failure diagnoses directly from complete visual collages and action logs. • Unified Three-Role Architecture: We formulate a single-model paradigm consolidating Student, Analyzer, and Teacher roles, internalizing state rollback during training while preserving zero computational and skill prompt overhead at inference. • Superior Performance: Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) ( + 8 % +8\% over the SFT+GRPO baseline and + 5 % +5\% over dense-reward SOTA) and scales to 0.92 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) ( + 12 % +12\% over the SFT+GRPO baseline).
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出P vot-Aware I nternalized V isual O n-Political T 雨(PIVOT),这是一个政策性蒸馏框架,将pivot步骤本地化和故障诊断提示直接引入参数更新而无需模拟器回滚(图1, Sec.3).
在第一阶段,一个轻量级的SFT阶段冷启动一个故障分析器到非侵入性地直接从视觉轨迹拼接和动作日志(Sec. 3.1)中预言了枢轴步骤,故障模式和可选导技能.

一个脱颖而出的老师随后在此特权背景下重新评分原创失败的代币,而学生则优化了GRPO和Gated OPD的联合目标(第3.2节).

blocks.en: 2.3 From Physical Rollbacks to Parameter-Internalized Updates
blocks.zh: 2.3 从物理回滚到参数-内部更新

blocks.en: These mechanistic findings expose the Rollback Paradox in post-training VLM agents: while trajectory recovery stems overwhelmingly from state rollback at the pivot turn ( t ∗ t^{\ast} ), explicit physical rollbacks are computationally prohibitive during online RL and impossible in real-world, non-rewindable environments.
blocks.zh: 这些机械学发现暴露了训练后 VLM 剂中的 " 反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向反向 " 。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap and convert physical state rollback directly into parameter updates without simulator resets, a practical post-training framework must fulfill three core requirements: (i) Non-Invasive Pivot Localization: identifying the critical pivot step ( t ∗ t^{\ast} ) directly from failure trajectory histories, bypassing environment resets; (ii) Internalized Credit Assignment: converting the localized pivot turn into fine-grained, token-level policy gradients directly on original failed rollouts without physical rollbacks; and (iii) Zero Test-Time Overhead: internalizing hindsight diagnostic capabilities into policy parameters to enable unprivileged deployment without additional skill prompts or auxiliary models at test time.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,将物理状态回滚直接转换为参数更新,而不使用模拟器重置器,实用的培训后框架必须满足三个核心要求:(一) 非侵入式重置定位:直接从故障轨迹历史中识别关键枢轴步骤(t * t^{\ast}),绕过环境重置器;(二) 内化式信用委托:将局部枢轴转换为精细的、象征性的政策梯度,直接在最初失败的推出上而不进行物理回滚;(三) 零试验-时间超头:将后视诊断能力内部化为政策参数,以便在试验时无需额外技能即时或辅助模型即可进行非优先部署。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: To evaluate the learning dynamics and visual reasoning capabilities of VLM agents, we adopt the VAGEN ( Wang et al., 2026b ) evaluation suite, comprising five agentic tasks across three paradigms: Cognitive Grid Puzzles, Embodied 3D Control, and Generative Reasoning. App. E details the task families, environment specifications, horizon limits, and metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了评价VLM代理的学习动态和视觉推理能力,我们采用了VAGEN(Wang et al., 2026b)评价套件,包括跨越三个范式的五个代理任务: 认知网格谜题 健美的3D控制 和基因理性 应用。 E详细列出任务家族,环境规格,视野限制,以及衡量标准.

blocks.en:
We evaluate PIVOT across two backbone models: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025a ) .
We compare against three reference baselines:
(i) Vanilla-GRPO : Pure RL post-training initialized directly from raw Instruct checkpoints with Analyzer components disabled;
(ii) SFT-GRPO : GRPO initialized from Stage I Analyzer SFT weights θ sft \theta_{\mathrm{sft}} (with OPD disabled during RL), isolating SFT initialization gains from token-level distillation; and
(iii) SDAR ( Lu et al., 2026 ) : A reproduced state-of-the-art on-policy distillation baseline using a frozen Qwen3-VL-7B-Instruct teacher and Qwen2.5-VL-3B student (More details in App. I ) with the same Gated OPD (Eq. 7 ), isolating Gated OPD’s contribution.

Performance across puzzle and embodied control tasks is evaluated using the average Success Rate (SR) under sparse goal-completion rewards. For SVG Reconstruction, we report a composite visual similarity score averaging DINO and DreamSim embeddings.

As presented in Tab. 1 , the full PIVOT framework ( M+P+R ) consistently outperforms all reference baselines across both backbones.
On Qwen2.5-VL-3B , M+P+R achieves a 0.90 0.90 overall accuracy , delivering a + 8 % +8\% gain over SFT-GRPO ( 0.83 → 0.90 0.83\to 0.90 ) and a + 13 % +13\% lift over pure Vanilla-GRPO .

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
VLMs serve as goal-driven agents across web navigation, device control, and embodied decision-making tasks ( Koh et al., 2024 ; Shridhar et al., 2021 ) .
Beyond test-time prompting with frozen backbones ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , task adaptability is enhanced via fine-tuning and online RL ( Bai et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2025 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) .
However, standard outcome RL and process supervision ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) rely on trial-and-error or dense shaping, providing coarse feedback that fails to isolate unrecoverable decision points.
Retrospective feedback from hindsight, reflection, and memory systems ( Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) yields post-hoc signals but incurs severe prompt-length and latency overhead at inference.
While on-policy distillation internalizes feedback into parameters via self-generated rollouts ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , agentic self-teachers remain structurally decoupled or prompt-dependent ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
In contrast, PIVOT localizes pivot turns from visual histories and distills token-level hindsight directly into policy parameters without dense shaping, extra prompts, or environment rollbacks.
blocks.zh:
VLMs是贯穿网络导航,设备控制以及包含决策任务的瞄准驱动剂(Koh等人,2024年;Shridhar等人,2021年).
在使用冷冻骨干推动测试时间之外(姚等人,2023年;申恩等人,2023年),通过微调和在线增强任务适应能力 RL(Bai等人,2025年b); 沈等人,2025;欧阳等人,2022).
然而,标准结果RL和过程监督(Schulman等人,2017年;Shao等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年;Lightman等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年)依靠试验和过敏或密集的塑造,提供粗糙的反馈,无法隔离无法恢复的决定点.
从后视、反射和内存系统的回顾反馈 (Andrychowicz等人,2017年;Madaan等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2024年;Wang等人,2023年) 产生热量后信号,但在推论上会产生严重的即时和延迟性。
虽然政策上蒸馏通过自我生成的推出将反馈内化为参数(Ross等人,2011年;Agarwal等人,2024年;Lu等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a年),但代理自导师仍然在结构上脱钩或迅速依赖(Wu等人,2026年)。
与此相对照,PIVOT本地化的枢轴从视觉历史中转换出来,蒸馏符号级的后照直接转化为政策参数,没有密集的形状,额外的提示,或者环境回滚.

blocks.en:
Outcome-based RL frequently suffers from policy entropy collapse, prematurely shrinking pass@ k k exploration diversity and trapping policies in local optima ( Yue et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
This degeneration is acute in multi-turn agent interaction ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) , where standard policy gradients over-reinforce frequent success paths while suppressing alternative exploration branches ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) .
In sequential settings, an uncorrected early blunder distorts subsequent state observations, compounding downstream execution errors and pruning viable subtrees ( Andrychowicz et al., 2017 ; Sinha et al., 2026 ) .
Although recent diversity-preserving techniques attempt to mitigate policy sharpening, they remain bound to trajectory-level returns or group-level advantages ( Sinha et al., 2026 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Kazemnejad et al., 2025 ) .
Consequently, they sustain only surface-level diversity without identifying the exact pivot turn where task failure originated ( Uesato et al., 2022 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . PIVOT bridges this credit-assignment gap by isolating critical pivot steps via visual panels and distilling confidence-gated token-level gradients onto failed rollouts, maintaining informative optimization even within zero-variance failure groups where conventional RL advantages vanish.
blocks.zh:
基于结果的RL经常受到政策性肽崩溃、过早收缩的传球@kk 探索多样性和陷阱政策的影响(Yue等人,2026年;Cui等人,2025年;Yu等人,2026年)。
这种衰变在多转动剂相互作用中十分尖锐(Wang等人,2026b;Li等人,2026),标准的政策梯度过强会经常成功,同时压制替代勘探分支(Schulman等人,2017;Cui等人,2025)。
在顺序设置中,一个未经纠正的早期错误扭曲了之后的状态观察,使下游执行错误复杂化,并挤压了可行的子树(Andrychowicz等人,2017年;Sinha等人,2026年).
虽然最近的保护多样性技术试图减少政策上的磨损,但它们仍然受制于轨迹水平的回报率或群体水平的优势(Sinha等人,2026年;Shao等人,2024年;Yu等人,2026年;Kazemnejad等人,2025年)。
因此,它们只维持地表一级的多样性,而没有确定任务失败起源的确切转弯(Uesato等人,2022年;Lightman等人,2024年)。 PIVOT通过通过视觉面板将关键的关键支点步骤隔离开来,并将信任级梯度提炼到失败的推出上,从而弥合这一信用分配差距,即使在常规RL优势消失的零变值失败组中,也保持信息优化。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: While PIVOT demonstrates strong performance and efficiency across multi-turn VLM agent tasks, several scope boundaries and promising directions for future work remain:
blocks.zh: 虽然PIVOT在多回合的VLM代理任务中表现出强劲的性能和效率,但未来工作的几个范围界限和有希望的方向仍然存在:

blocks.en: • Pivot Supervision Source & Discovery: Stage I SFT currently relies on offline target labels generated via feasibility heuristics. Extending PIVOT to complex environments lacking explicit solvers presents an exciting opportunity for unsupervised or self-diagnostic pivot discovery. Inspired by recent insights on token-level uncertainty and self-adaptation ( Ding and Zhang, 2026 ) , the pivot step t ∗ t^{\ast} could be determined intrinsically using token-level entropy metrics (e.g., locating critical state transitions via minimum-entropy positions), or empirically via rollout sampling by identifying the step where the suffix return lift growth is minimized. • Task Domain Applicability: The current definition of the pivot step t ∗ t^{\ast} relies on remaining-budget goal reachability, which naturally aligns with structured visual environments. Adapting it to open-ended dialogue or continuous control may use dynamic, probabilistic, or entropy-guided reachability. • Model Scale and Physical Realization: Our evaluation focuses on compact VLM backbones (Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen3-VL-2B) within simulated benchmarks. Scaling this internalized distillation recipe to larger parameters and non-rewindable physical robotic systems represents an important direction for future exploration.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we address the credit assignment bottleneck of outcome-based RL in multi-turn VLM agents.
Our analysis shows that post-failure recovery is driven by physical state restoration at pivot steps ( t ∗ t^{\ast} ), rather than textual skill guidance.
To avoid prohibitive simulator rollbacks, we present PIVOT , which internalizes visual state restoration into a unified Student-Analyzer-Teacher policy.
By localizing t ∗ t^{\ast} and distilling gated hindsight onto failed rollouts, PIVOT removes physical resets at training and prompt overhead at deployment, outperforming SOTAs and prior distillation methods.
